def max_abs_diff(arr):
    """
    Returns the maximum absolute difference between any two elements in the list `arr`.
    
    The largest possible difference is simply:
        max(arr) - min(arr)
    
    This works because for any pair (a, b), |a - b| ≤ max(arr) - min(arr).
    """
    if len(arr) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Array must contain at least two elements.")
    
    return max(arr) - min(arr)
